transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1378 Cloudmount Drive?
Yes, this is 1378 Cloudmount Drive. Everyone’s safe inside, no water in the house.
Thank you for confirming the address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Four people are here. No one can’t come to the phone.

Got it, four people here, no one can’t come to the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave on their own. No wheelchair or medical needs here.
Understood, no one is unable to leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. Everyone’s safe and can stay put.
Understood, no water inside, everyone safe and can stay put. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats.
Got it, no truck, no boat, no free seats. Let me read that back: 4 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Four people. No water inside.
Thank you for confirming the details. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
